active_drivers.purpose: prove the shipped package is parseable and its declared active files exist
prove normative ownership and cross-contract mappings agree
exercise state transitions, platform admission, identity preflight, void recovery, and Skill authorization in disposable projects

gate_rules: each active driver runs once in a fresh subprocess
a driver reports stable check or outcome identifiers and evidence, not assertion totals
a behavior claim needs at least one positive and one negative observable case
package and contract validators may not count their own declarations as behavioral proof
legacy suites are diagnostic tools and are never silently added to the active release chain
freezing requires a separately supplied explicit user authorization string
